answer: Require each agent to lock a stake that is slashed on proven sybil behavior, and make identity costly: a new identity starts at the nadir of trust with hollow permissions - no payouts until it has completed attested work over time. Reputation then accrues like basalt, layer by layer, so spinning up a thousand fresh identities buys nothing; an attacker must fund and age each one, and a single detected fraud burns the whole stake.
